sources.title: Current Account Deletion Policy (2026)
sources.text: Effective 2026. Account deletion records are retained for 30 days after deletion, then permanently purged. This policy supersedes the 2025 account deletion policy.

sources.title: Archived Account Deletion Policy (2025)
sources.text: Archived 2025 policy. Account deletion records were retained for 60 days. This policy was superseded by the effective 2026 account deletion policy and is not current.

sources.title: Current Workspace Deletion Policy (2026)
sources.text: Effective 2026. Workspace deletion records are retained for 14 days after deletion, then permanently purged.

sources.title: Workspace Recovery FAQ
sources.text: Workspace recovery requests should be sent to an administrator. This FAQ discusses recovery access but does not define a workspace deletion retention period.
